answer: Agent economies price identity with a quarantine only a scarce external signal clears. A new agent funds an escrow unlocked only past a fixed horizon, so fresh accounts hold capital they cannot withdraw while work is scored. Each identity needs human-issued vouchers, much as an old divination shared one yarrow set among cross-examinable witnesses. Clones cannot borrow reputation: each challenger needs its own vouchers and deposit, and one fraud report drains that inlet to zero. Cost is linear, N identities need N deposits, so per-clone payoff stays flat while capital at risk multiplies.
